assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original professional game wordmark for a dark website header and sign-in screen, rendered as a clean wide logo asset with actual alpha transparency.
Primary request: Create a striking premium, sharp, highly legible original MY RP logo. The exact main text is "MY RP". Design an angular road/intersection-inspired monogram integrated with or immediately left of the wordmark. Bespoke strong geometric lettering, confident proportions, minimal decisive geometry, flat vector-friendly finish. Keep the entire logo one coherent horizontal unit with a tight, usable bounding box and generous clear margin.
Color palette: platinum/ivory #f5f3ec letterforms with restrained warm amber #ffb052 accent; designed for midnight #0a0e17 and charcoal #151c28 backgrounds. No background is drawn.
Text (verbatim): "MY RP". This must be the only text; spell M Y, space, R P exactly, and make each letter immediately readable even at small header scale.
Constraints: real transparent background, preserve alpha, flat crisp isolated artwork, no shadows, no mockup, no texture, no scenery, no luminous haze. Entire lettering and mark fully in frame. An original urban roleplay identity; do not resemble any known franchise.
Avoid: shields, badges, crowns, police insignia, swords, animals, gradients, glossy bevels, ornate detail, extra slogans, extra letters, watermarks, copied game designs.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the attached transparent MY RP logo.
Primary request: Clean this exact logo into immaculate professional flat vector-like artwork. Keep the same horizontal monogram plus exact MY RP wordmark, the same composition, overall proportions, ivory and warm amber colors, and recognizable letter geometry.
Change only: remove all stray speckles, edge grit, mottling, holes, random pixels, off-white debris and accidental roughness around and inside the logo. Rebuild the intended edges as smooth straight crisp geometric boundaries and solid flat fills. Preserve intended negative-space cutouts and clear gaps between letters. Remove any bevel or texture; this is clean flat brand artwork.
Text (verbatim): "MY RP", M Y, space, R P. No other text.
Constraints: ACTUAL TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with clean alpha; nothing outside the intentional logo geometry. Entire logo in frame, clean transparent margins on every side. No black rectangle or checkerboard drawn in the image. No added symbols, no shadows, no glow, no texture, no redesign.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide cinematic premium game loading and website entry background, original key art for MY RP / My Roleplay. This is concept illustration, not an in-engine screenshot.
Primary request: A grounded, richly detailed stylized-realistic 3D Nigerian city roleplay illustration at blue-hour twilight. Two mature adult Nigerian civilian protagonists, a poised dark-skinned woman around age 32 with natural hair and stylish contemporary indigo casual tailoring, and a confident dark-skinned man around age 35 with short natural hair, a clean contemporary jacket and trousers. They stand naturally near one elegant modern unbranded dark sedan on a broad city street. They feel like residents beginning an ambitious everyday city life.
Scene/backdrop: Warm inhabited Nigerian coastal city with contemporary apartments, offices, streetlights, palms, and a distant urban bridge. Authentic attractive contemporary Nigerian urban atmosphere; refined everyday civilian life, calm and aspirational. Rain has recently stopped; subtle amber streetlight reflections on the road. Deep navy twilight sky, realistic glass and architecture, sophisticated atmospheric depth.
Composition/framing: Extra-wide landscape cinematic frame, panoramic 16:9 or wider. Position the two protagonists and sedan mainly in the lower middle and center-right, around 52–68 percent of image width. The left 40 percent stays quiet and dark with low-contrast twilight sky and distant architecture, deliberately usable behind actual HTML headings. The rightmost 30 percent is also quieter, darker architectural distance and soft sky for a sign-in panel, so no faces or important car details there. Show both adult people at least to knees, believable natural anatomy and confident relaxed poses. Rich depth and hero detail concentrated across the central foreground.
Lighting/mood: Midnight navy #0a0e17 and charcoal #151c28 shadows, warm amber #ffb052 practical light reflections, subtle cobalt #5d8cff ambience, elegant ivory highlights #f5f3ec. Cinematic but grounded, high production-value original 3D game key art with tasteful detail and clear focal hierarchy.
Constraints: No text, no typography, no logos, no watermarks, no UI, no weapons, no uniforms, no children, no flags, no identifiable vehicle badges, no futuristic aircraft, no cloned franchise characters or copied OneState/Sims assets. The two adult protagonists must look distinctly Nigerian and civilian. Keep the composition calm enough for interface overlays, with the entire left 40 percent quiet.
